13549    /// Verifies that `session_initiations` is cleaned up when `new_session` fails to
13550    /// send the StartSession message (e.g. the underlying channel is closed).
13551    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
13552    async fn new_session_removes_challenge_on_send_failure() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
13553        let mgr: SessionManager<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>> =
13554            SessionManager::new(Default::default());
13555
13556        // Create a channel whose receiver is dropped immediately.  When the mock
13557        // transport tries to `send` over this channel the call will return an error,
13558        // which propagates up through `send_via_msg_sender` as
13559        // `TransportSessionError::packet_sending`.
13560        let (tx, rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
13561        drop(rx);
13562
13563        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
13564        let _notifications = tokio::spawn(async move {
13565            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
13566            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
13567        });
13568        mgr.start(tx, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
13569        assert!(mgr.is_started());
13570
13571        // Verify that sending fails because the receiver is gone.
13572        let result = mgr
13573            .new_session(
13574                Address::from(&ChainKeypair::random()),
13575                SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
13576                SessionClientConfig {
13577                    surb_management: None,
13578                    ..Default::default()
13579                },
13580            )
13581            .await;
13582
13583        assert!(result.is_err());
13584        assert_eq!(mgr.num_active_sessions(), 0);
13585        // The challenge must have been removed from `session_initiations` even
13586        // though the send failed.
13587        assert_eq!(
13588            mgr.session_initiations.entry_count(),
13589            0,
13590            "session_initiations was not cleaned up after send failure"
13591        );
13592
13593        Ok(())
13594    }

13668    /// The manager sink type used by the dispatch drop tests, which never open a session and so
13669    /// never exercise the sink — its concrete type only needs to be nameable.
13670    #[cfg(test)]
13671    type TestManager =
13672        SessionManager<futures::channel::mpsc::UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>;
13673
13674    // Test B (fully deregistered): a data packet for a session id absent from the registry is a
13675    // benign, quiet drop counted as UnknownData — NOT an error, and NOT one ERROR log per packet.
13676    // Under the old behaviour this returned `Err(UnknownData)` and the caller logged it at ERROR,
13677    // which is what produced the per-packet spam during the incident.
13678    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
13679    async fn dispatching_to_an_unregistered_session_should_be_a_quiet_counted_drop() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
13680        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
13681
13682        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
13683        let before = crate::counters::session_unknown_data_drop_count();
13684
13685        // N packets → N drops, each an Ok(Dropped(Unregistered)), no panic, no unbounded error.
13686        const N: usize = 5;
13687        for _ in 0..N {
13688            let result = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_data_packet(b"test data")?);
13689            assert!(
13690                matches!(result, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::Unregistered))),
13691                "unregistered-session packet must be a benign Dropped(Unregistered), got {result:?}"
13692            );
13693        }
13694
13695        // Counter advanced by at least N (>= rather than == because it is a process-global atomic
13696        // other tests in this binary may also touch).
13697        assert!(crate::counters::session_unknown_data_drop_count() >= before + N);
13698
13699        Ok(())
13700    }
13701
13702    // Test A (primary regression): a data packet for a session whose data sink has been dropped
13703    // while the slot is still registered must be dropped quietly as SinkClosed — NOT an error.
13704    // This is the "sending on a disconnected channel" ERROR from the incident. The bad-behaviour
13705    // assertion is the silent-vs-loud distinction: the result is Ok(Dropped(SinkClosed)), not Err,
13706    // and specifically not SinkFull (which would misattribute a teardown as backpressure).
13707    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
13708    async fn dispatching_to_a_session_whose_sink_closed_should_be_a_quiet_counted_drop() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
13709        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
13710
13711        // `pre_populate_session` registers the slot and immediately drops its receiver, so the
13712        // sink is closed while the slot is still present — exactly the incident's race.
13713        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
13714        mgr.pre_populate_session(pseudonym, DestinationRouting::Return(pseudonym.into()));
13715
13716        let before = crate::counters::session_inbox_closed_drop_count();
13717        let result = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_data_packet(b"after teardown")?);
13718
13719        assert!(
13720            matches!(result, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::SinkClosed))),
13721            "closed-sink packet must be a benign Dropped(SinkClosed), not an error or SinkFull, got {result:?}"
13722        );
13723        assert!(crate::counters::session_inbox_closed_drop_count() > before);
13724
13725        Ok(())
13726    }
13727
13728    // Genuine backpressure (inbox full, reader alive but not keeping up) is distinct from a
13729    // teardown: it is Dropped(SinkFull) and counted in SESSION_INBOX_DROPS, not the closed counter.
13730    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
13731    async fn dispatching_to_a_full_session_inbox_should_be_a_backpressure_drop() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
13732        // Capacity 1 so a single unread packet fills the inbox deterministically.
13733        let cfg = SessionManagerConfig {
13734            session_forward_capacity: 1,
13735            ..Default::default()
13736        };
13737        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(cfg);
13738
13739        // Keep the receiver alive but never read it, so the channel is open but saturates.
13740        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
13741        let _rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(pseudonym, DestinationRouting::Return(pseudonym.into()));
13742
13743        // First packet fills the single slot and is accepted.
13744        let accepted = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_data_packet(b"fills the slot")?);
13745        assert!(
13746            matches!(accepted, Ok(DispatchResult::Processed)),
13747            "first packet should be accepted, got {accepted:?}"
13748        );
13749
13750        // Second packet finds the inbox full → backpressure drop.
13751        let before = crate::counters::session_inbox_drop_count();
13752        let overflow = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_data_packet(b"overflows")?);
13753        assert!(
13754            matches!(overflow, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::SinkFull))),
13755            "overflow packet must be a Dropped(SinkFull) backpressure drop, got {overflow:?}"
13756        );
13757        assert!(crate::counters::session_inbox_drop_count() > before);
13758
13759        Ok(())
13760    }

13762    /// A packet reporting that some of the SURBs it carried were dropped on arrival.
13763    /// An Entry-side slot whose organic SURB gate is closed: a target of 100 against a believed
13764    /// level of 200. Anything that reopens it in the tests below did so on the counterparty's word.
13765    fn entry_slot_with_closed_gate(
13766        mgr: &TestManager,
13767        pseudonym: HoprPseudonym,
13768    ) -> anyhow::Result<crossfire::AsyncRx<crossfire::mpsc::Array<ApplicationDataIn>>> {
13769        let rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(
13770            pseudonym,
13771            DestinationRouting::Forward {
13772                destination: Box::new(Address::from(&ChainKeypair::random()).into()),
13773                pseudonym: Some(pseudonym),
13774                forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(1.try_into()?),
13775                return_options: None,
13776            },
13777        );
13778
13779        let slot = mgr
13780            .sessions
13781            .get(&pseudonym)
13782            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("slot must exist"))?;
13783        slot.surb_mgmt.update(&SurbBalancerConfig {
13784            target_surb_buffer_size: 100,
13785            ..Default::default()
13786        });
13787        slot.surb_mgmt
13788            .buffer_level
13789            .store(200, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
13790        anyhow::ensure!(
13791            0 == slot.surb_mgmt.organic_surbs_per_packet(),
13792            "precondition: the gate must start closed"
13793        );
13794
13795        Ok(rx)
13796    }

13798    /// The organic SURB cap the slot's gate currently answers.
13799    fn organic_surbs(mgr: &TestManager, pseudonym: HoprPseudonym) -> Option<usize> {
13800        mgr.sessions
13801            .get(&pseudonym)
13802            .map(|slot| slot.surb_mgmt.organic_surbs_per_packet())
13803    }

13805    /// The Exit → Entry return-SURB credit the slot has accumulated, which the successor gate is
13806    /// denominated in.
13807    fn returned_packets_of(mgr: &TestManager, pseudonym: HoprPseudonym) -> u64 {
13808        mgr.sessions
13809            .get(&pseudonym)
13810            .expect("slot must exist")
13811            .returned_packets
13812            .load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed)
13813    }
13814
13815    fn session_packet_signalling(signals: PacketSignals) -> anyhow::Result<ApplicationDataIn> {
13816        let mut data = session_data_packet(b"reply")?;
13817        data.packet_info.signals_from_sender = signals;
13818        Ok(data)
13819    }
13820
13821    fn keep_alive_packet_signalling(
13822        session_id: SessionId,
13823        signals: PacketSignals,
13824    ) -> anyhow::Result<ApplicationDataIn> {
13825        Ok(ApplicationDataIn {
13826            data: ApplicationData::try_from(HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(KeepAliveMessage {
13827                session_id,
13828                flags: KeepAliveFlag::BalancerState.into(),
13829                additional_data: 0,
13830            }))?,
13831            packet_info: IncomingPacketInfo {
13832                signals_from_sender: signals,
13833                ..Default::default()
13834            },
13835        })
13836    }
13837
13838    /// The regression: a packet dropped for local backpressure still carries what the counterparty
13839    /// said about its own SURB supply. Recorded only once the Session reads the packet, that word is
13840    /// lost exactly when the inbox is saturated — leaving organic production shut off on an estimate
13841    /// the counterparty has just contradicted, and with nothing else able to reopen it.
13842    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
13843    async fn distress_should_be_recorded_even_when_the_packet_is_dropped() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
13844        // Capacity 1, so the second packet deterministically finds the inbox full.
13845        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(SessionManagerConfig {
13846            session_forward_capacity: 1,
13847            ..Default::default()
13848        });
13849        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
13850        let _rx = entry_slot_with_closed_gate(&mgr, pseudonym)?;
13851
13852        // Fill the single slot; nothing reads it.
13853        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_packet_signalling(PacketSignals::default())?)?;
13854
13855        let dropped = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_packet_signalling(PacketSignal::SurbDistress.into())?)?;
13856        assert!(
13857            matches!(dropped, DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::SinkFull)),
13858            "the fixture must actually drop this packet, got {dropped:?}"
13859        );
13860        assert_eq!(
13861            Some(1),
13862            organic_surbs(&mgr, pseudonym),
13863            "a dropped packet still spoke for the counterparty"
13864        );
13865
13866        Ok(())
13867    }
13868
13869    /// Keep-alives are all a Session that has stopped exchanging data still sends, and they reach
13870    /// `handle_keep_alive` stripped of their packet info — so before this was recorded at dispatch,
13871    /// a quiet counterparty could not report distress at all.
13872    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
13873    async fn distress_should_be_recorded_from_a_keep_alive() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
13874        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
13875        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
13876        let _rx = entry_slot_with_closed_gate(&mgr, pseudonym)?;
13877
13878        // The manager is not started, so the Start-protocol worker rejects this after the signal has
13879        // been taken from it. That is the property under test: the record does not depend on
13880        // anything downstream succeeding.
13881        let _ = mgr.dispatch_message(
13882            pseudonym,
13883            keep_alive_packet_signalling(pseudonym, PacketSignal::OutOfSurbs.into())?,
13884        );
13885
13886        assert_eq!(Some(1), organic_surbs(&mgr, pseudonym));
13887
13888        Ok(())
13889    }
13890
13891    /// An Exit → Entry Start packet consumes a return SURB whatever it decodes to and wherever it
13892    /// is admitted, so the credit that denominates the successor gate must be paid before the
13893    /// decode and the admission filter, not after them. A packet the filter rejects has already
13894    /// spent the SURB — under-crediting it can make the gate refuse the next `RequestSsa` and the
13895    /// Session close with `CommitmentTimeout`.
13896    ///
13897    /// ## Steps
13898    /// 1. An Entry-side (`Forward`) slot is pre-populated with its gate closed.
13899    /// 2. A `KeepAlive` naming another Session — the filter's mismatched-pseudonym drop — must still credit
13900    ///    `returned_packets` by one.
13901    /// 3. A Start-tagged packet that fails to decode must credit it by one too.
13902    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
13903    async fn a_start_packet_the_filter_drops_should_still_credit_the_returned_packets() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
13904        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
13905        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
13906        let _rx = entry_slot_with_closed_gate(&mgr, pseudonym)?;
13907        let before = returned_packets_of(&mgr, pseudonym);
13908
13909        // The manager is not started, but that only matters past the filter; this one is dropped at
13910        // the filter itself, for naming a Session the pseudonym it arrives under does not own.
13911        let dropped = mgr.dispatch_message(
13912            pseudonym,
13913            keep_alive_packet_signalling(HoprPseudonym::random(), PacketSignals::default())?,
13914        )?;
13915        assert!(
13916            matches!(dropped, DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage)),
13917            "the fixture must actually drop this packet at the filter, got {dropped:?}"
13918        );
13919        assert_eq!(
13920            before + 1,
13921            returned_packets_of(&mgr, pseudonym),
13922            "a packet the filter drops has already consumed its return SURB"
13923        );
13924
13925        Ok(())
13926    }
13927
13928    /// The undecodable half of the same regression: the decode runs after the credit, so a
13929    /// Start-tagged packet that fails to parse must still have credited the return SURB it spent.
13930    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
13931    async fn an_undecodable_start_packet_should_still_credit_the_returned_packets() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
13932        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
13933        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
13934        let _rx = entry_slot_with_closed_gate(&mgr, pseudonym)?;
13935        let before = returned_packets_of(&mgr, pseudonym);
13936
13937        // Start-protocol tag, but a payload that parses to no Start-protocol message.
13938        let mut undecodable = session_data_packet(b"not a start message")?;
13939        undecodable.data.application_tag = HoprStartProtocol::START_PROTOCOL_MESSAGE_TAG;
13940
13941        let result = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, undecodable);
13942        assert!(
13943            result.is_err(),
13944            "the fixture must actually fail to decode this packet, got {result:?}"
13945        );
13946        assert_eq!(
13947            before + 1,
13948            returned_packets_of(&mgr, pseudonym),
13949            "a packet that cannot be decoded has already consumed its return SURB"
13950        );
13951
13952        Ok(())
13953    }
13954
13955    /// Distress is a running state, not a latch: the counterparty recomputes it per packet and stops
13956    /// setting it once its pool recovers, so a clean packet has to close the gate again.
13957    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
13958    async fn a_clean_packet_should_clear_distress() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
13959        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
13960        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
13961        let _rx = entry_slot_with_closed_gate(&mgr, pseudonym)?;
13962
13963        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_packet_signalling(PacketSignal::SurbDistress.into())?)?;
13964        assert_eq!(Some(1), organic_surbs(&mgr, pseudonym), "precondition: distress is set");
13965
13966        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_packet_signalling(PacketSignals::default())?)?;
13967        assert_eq!(Some(0), organic_surbs(&mgr, pseudonym));
13968
13969        Ok(())
13970    }
13971
13972    /// The gate governs SURBs this side mints *for* its counterparty, which only the initiator does.
13973    /// On an incoming Session the same signal describes our own supply coming back to us, and acting
13974    /// on it would let a peer talk this side into minting for a buffer it does not keep.
13975    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
13976    async fn distress_should_be_ignored_on_an_incoming_session() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
13977        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
13978        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
13979        let _rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(pseudonym, DestinationRouting::Return(pseudonym.into()));
13980
13981        let slot = mgr
13982            .sessions
13983            .get(&pseudonym)
13984            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("slot must exist"))?;
13985        slot.surb_mgmt.update(&SurbBalancerConfig {
13986            target_surb_buffer_size: 100,
13987            ..Default::default()
13988        });
13989        slot.surb_mgmt
13990            .buffer_level
13991            .store(200, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
13992
13993        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, session_packet_signalling(PacketSignal::OutOfSurbs.into())?)?;
13994
13995        assert_eq!(
13996            Some(0),
13997            organic_surbs(&mgr, pseudonym),
13998            "an incoming Session must not take the signal as licence to mint"
13999        );
14000
14001        Ok(())
14002    }
14003
14004    /// Encodes a [`HoprStartProtocol`] message into the packet form `dispatch_message` takes.
14005    ///
14006    /// The Start tag is what `dispatch_message` routes on, exactly as
14007    /// [`keep_alive_packet_signalling`] builds its packet.
14008    fn start_packet(msg: HoprStartProtocol) -> anyhow::Result<ApplicationDataIn> {
14009        Ok(ApplicationDataIn {
14010            data: ApplicationData::try_from(msg)?,
14011            packet_info: Default::default(),
14012        })
14013    }
14014
14015    /// An `SsaRequest` for `session_id` with a single identity-element commitment.
14016    ///
14017    /// The Exit-side point is not checked in dispatch, so the identity element
14018    /// ([`ssa_request_for`]) is enough for the message to be decodable and well-formed.
14019    fn ssa_request_packet(session_id: SessionId) -> anyhow::Result<ApplicationDataIn> {
14020        start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SsaRequest(SsaServerCommitmentMessage::new(
14021            session_id,
14022            small_pix_params(),
14023            ssa_request_for(1),
14024            [],
14025        )))
14026    }
14027
14028    /// A flood of `SsaRequest`s for pseudonyms this node never issued must be rejected at dispatch.
14029    ///
14030    /// Before the admission filter, every one of these reached the shared Start-protocol worker
14031    /// pool, where `handle_ssa_request` parked its handler for up to a second on a Session slot a
14032    /// random pseudonym never gets; ~110 concurrent requests occupied every handler and the bounded
14033    /// Start queue then dropped all traffic behind them — including the KeepAlives of live Sessions.
14034    ///
14035    /// ## Steps
14036    /// 1. A manager holds one live (pre-populated Forward) Session.
14037    /// 2. ~300 `SsaRequest`s are dispatched, each for a fresh random pseudonym.
14038    /// 3. Every one must come back `Dropped(StaleStartMessage)`, counted, and nothing may reach the bounded queue — the
14039    ///    send-drop counter must not move.
14040    /// 4. A `KeepAlive` for the live Session's own pseudonym must still be dispatched, proving the flood cannot have
14041    ///    starved real control traffic.
14042    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
14043    async fn a_flood_of_ssa_requests_for_unknown_pseudonyms_must_not_starve_a_live_session() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
14044        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
14045
14046        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
14047        let _notifications = tokio::spawn(async move {
14048            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
14049            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
14050        });
14051        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(MockMsgSender::new());
14052        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, None)?;
14053
14054        let live_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
14055        let _rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(
14056            live_pseudonym,
14057            DestinationRouting::Forward {
14058                destination: Box::new(Address::from(&ChainKeypair::random()).into()),
14059                pseudonym: Some(live_pseudonym),
14060                forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(1.try_into()?),
14061                return_options: None,
14062            },
14063        );
14064
14065        let stale_before = crate::counters::session_stale_start_message_count();
14066        let send_drops_before = crate::counters::start_protocol_send_drop_count();
14067
14068        const FLOOD: usize = 300;
14069        for _ in 0..FLOOD {
14070            let stranger = HoprPseudonym::random();
14071            let result = mgr.dispatch_message(stranger, ssa_request_packet(stranger)?);
14072            assert!(
14073                matches!(result, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage))),
14074                "an SSA request for a pseudonym this node never issued must be dropped as stale, got {result:?}"
14075            );
14076        }
14077
14078        assert!(
14079            crate::counters::session_stale_start_message_count() >= stale_before + FLOOD,
14080            "every flooded request must be counted as a stale Start message"
14081        );
14082        assert_eq!(
14083            send_drops_before,
14084            crate::counters::start_protocol_send_drop_count(),
14085            "nothing may reach the bounded queue: the filter must run before try_send"
14086        );
14087
14088        // The live Session's control traffic must still be dispatched — the property the flood used
14089        // to destroy by filling the queue.
14090        let kept_alive = mgr.dispatch_message(
14091            live_pseudonym,
14092            keep_alive_packet_signalling(live_pseudonym, PacketSignals::default())?,
14093        );
14094        assert!(
14095            matches!(kept_alive, Ok(DispatchResult::Processed)),
14096            "the live Session's keep-alive must still get through, got {kept_alive:?}"
14097        );
14098        assert_eq!(
14099            send_drops_before,
14100            crate::counters::start_protocol_send_drop_count(),
14101            "the keep-alive must not have been dropped at try_send either"
14102        );
14103
14104        sender.close_channel();
14105        Ok(())
14106    }
14107
14108    /// The filter must not be broader than the attack: an `SsaRequest` an Exit legitimately sends to
14109    /// its Entry is admitted, while the same request arriving on an Exit-side (Return) slot — which
14110    /// no compliant peer ever sends — is dropped as stale.
14111    ///
14112    /// ## Steps
14113    /// 1. A manager holds one Forward (outgoing/Entry-side) slot.
14114    /// 2. An `SsaRequest` naming it is admitted to the queue.
14115    /// 3. A second Return (incoming/Exit-side) slot; the same request naming it is dropped.
14116    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
14117    async fn an_ssa_request_for_an_outgoing_session_is_admitted_and_one_for_an_exit_slot_is_not() -> anyhow::Result<()>
14118    {
14119        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
14120
14121        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
14122        let _notifications = tokio::spawn(async move {
14123            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
14124            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
14125        });
14126        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(MockMsgSender::new());
14127        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, None)?;
14128
14129        // Outgoing (Entry-side) slot: the Entry receives SSA commitments for it, so the request is
14130        // legitimate and must be admitted.
14131        let entry_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
14132        let _entry_rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(
14133            entry_pseudonym,
14134            DestinationRouting::Forward {
14135                destination: Box::new(Address::from(&ChainKeypair::random()).into()),
14136                pseudonym: Some(entry_pseudonym),
14137                forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(1.try_into()?),
14138                return_options: None,
14139            },
14140        );
14141        let admitted = mgr.dispatch_message(entry_pseudonym, ssa_request_packet(entry_pseudonym)?);
14142        assert!(
14143            matches!(admitted, Ok(DispatchResult::Processed)),
14144            "an SSA request for an outgoing Session must be admitted, got {admitted:?}"
14145        );
14146
14147        // Incoming (Exit-side) slot: nothing here ever receives an SSA commitment for one.
14148        let exit_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
14149        let _exit_rx =
14150            mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(exit_pseudonym, DestinationRouting::Return(exit_pseudonym.into()));
14151        let refused = mgr.dispatch_message(exit_pseudonym, ssa_request_packet(exit_pseudonym)?);
14152        assert!(
14153            matches!(refused, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage))),
14154            "an SSA request for an incoming Session must be dropped as stale, got {refused:?}"
14155        );
14156
14157        sender.close_channel();
14158        Ok(())
14159    }
14160
14161    /// The filter's remaining arms: an `SsaCommit` is admitted only for a registered Session named
14162    /// under its own pseudonym, and a `SessionEstablished` or `SessionError(Challenge)` only for a
14163    /// challenge this node is still waiting on.
14164    ///
14165    /// ## Steps
14166    /// 1. A started manager holds one Return (Exit-side) slot, which is where `SsaCommit`s go, and two pending
14167    ///    initiation challenges — one per reply, so the handler consuming one cannot race the other's dispatch.
14168    /// 2. Each message naming state the node lacks is dropped as stale: an `SsaCommit` for an unregistered Session or
14169    ///    naming the slot under another pseudonym, and a `SessionEstablished` and a `SessionError` for a challenge
14170    ///    nobody issued.
14171    /// 3. Each message naming that state is admitted.
14172    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
14173    async fn ssa_commits_and_initiation_replies_are_admitted_only_for_local_state() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
14174        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
14175
14176        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
14177        let _notifications = tokio::spawn(async move {
14178            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
14179            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
14180        });
14181        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(MockMsgSender::new());
14182        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, None)?;
14183
14184        let exit_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
14185        let _exit_rx =
14186            mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(exit_pseudonym, DestinationRouting::Return(exit_pseudonym.into()));
14187
14188        // Reserved the way `new_session` reserves them. The receivers are kept so that a reply the
14189        // handler forwards has somewhere to go.
14190        let established_challenge = MIN_CHALLENGE;
14191        let error_challenge = MIN_CHALLENGE + 1;
14192        let unknown_challenge = MIN_CHALLENGE + 2;
14193        let _receivers = [established_challenge, error_challenge]
14194            .into_iter()
14195            .map(|challenge| {
14196                let (tx, rx): (
14197                    crossfire::MTx<crossfire::mpsc::One<_>>,
14198                    crossfire::AsyncRx<crossfire::mpsc::One<_>>,
14199                ) = crossfire::mpsc::build(crossfire::mpsc::One::new());
14200                mgr.session_initiations.insert(challenge, tx);
14201                rx
14202            })
14203            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
14204
14205        let identity = HoprPixGroupElement::try_from(
14206            hopr_protocol_pix::PixGroup::<HoprPixSpec>::default()
14207                .to_bytes()
14208                .as_ref(),
14209        )
14210        .ok()
14211        .context("identity element must be valid")?;
14212        // A non-constant term, so it is well-formed without a commitment proof.
14213        let ssa_commit = |session_id: SessionId| {
14214            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SsaCommit(SsaClientCommitmentMessage {
14215                session_id,
14216                ssa_index: SsaIndex::new(1).context("non-zero")?,
14217                coefficient_index: 1,
14218                commitment_proof: None,
14219                coefficient_commitments: [(0, identity)].into(),
14220            }))
14221        };
14222        // The filter keys both replies on the challenge alone, not on the pseudonym they arrive under.
14223        let replier = HoprPseudonym::random();
14224        let established = |orig_challenge: StartChallenge| {
14225            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SessionEstablished(StartEstablished {
14226                orig_challenge,
14227                session_id: replier,
14228            }))
14229        };
14230        let error = |challenge: StartChallenge| {
14231            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(StartErrorType {
14232                identifier: ErrorIdentifier::Challenge(challenge),
14233                reason: StartErrorReason::Unknown,
14234            }))
14235        };
14236
14237        let stranger = HoprPseudonym::random();
14238        for (case, pseudonym, packet) in [
14239            (
14240                "an SsaCommit for an unregistered Session",
14241                stranger,
14242                ssa_commit(stranger)?,
14243            ),
14244            (
14245                "an SsaCommit naming a registered Session under another pseudonym",
14246                stranger,
14247                ssa_commit(exit_pseudonym)?,
14248            ),
14249            (
14250                "a SessionEstablished for a challenge nobody issued",
14251                replier,
14252                established(unknown_challenge)?,
14253            ),
14254            (
14255                "a SessionError for a challenge nobody issued",
14256                replier,
14257                error(unknown_challenge)?,
14258            ),
14259        ] {
14260            let result = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet);
14261            assert!(
14262                matches!(result, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage))),
14263                "{case} must be dropped as stale, got {result:?}"
14264            );
14265        }
14266
14267        for (case, pseudonym, packet) in [
14268            (
14269                "an SsaCommit for a registered Session",
14270                exit_pseudonym,
14271                ssa_commit(exit_pseudonym)?,
14272            ),
14273            (
14274                "a SessionEstablished for a pending challenge",
14275                replier,
14276                established(established_challenge)?,
14277            ),
14278            (
14279                "a SessionError for a pending challenge",
14280                replier,
14281                error(error_challenge)?,
14282            ),
14283        ] {
14284            let result = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet);
14285            assert!(
14286                matches!(result, Ok(DispatchResult::Processed)),
14287                "{case} must be admitted, got {result:?}"
14288            );
14289        }
14290
14291        sender.close_channel();
14292        Ok(())
14293    }
14294
14295    /// Keep-alives and post-establishment session errors naming another Session must be ignored.
14296    ///
14297    /// A sender names a Session both by the pseudonym it sends under and by the Session id inside
14298    /// the message; the two are the same on both sides of a real Session, so a mismatch means the
14299    /// sender is speaking about someone else's Session — only reachable if that id leaked. The
14300    /// dispatch filter rejects such a message outright, and the handlers refuse it again (point 4 of
14301    /// the fix) so the property does not rest on dispatch alone.
14302    ///
14303    /// ## Steps
14304    /// 1. Two Return slots A and B are pre-populated with known balancer targets.
14305    /// 2. A `KeepAlive { session_id: B }` arriving under A is refused — at dispatch, and again by the handler when
14306    ///    reached directly — and B's balancer target is untouched.
14307    /// 3. A `SessionError { identifier: SessionId(B) }` arriving under A is refused the same way, and B stays active.
14308    /// 4. Control: the same messages under B's own pseudonym do take effect.
14309    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
14310    async fn keep_alives_and_session_errors_naming_another_session_are_ignored() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
14311        let mgr: TestManager = SessionManager::new(Default::default());
14312
14313        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
14314        let _notifications = tokio::spawn(async move {
14315            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
14316            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
14317        });
14318        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(MockMsgSender::new());
14319        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, None)?;
14320
14321        let a = HoprPseudonym::random();
14322        let b = HoprPseudonym::random();
14323        for pseudonym in [a, b] {
14324            let _rx = mgr.pre_populate_session_with_receiver(pseudonym, DestinationRouting::Return(pseudonym.into()));
14325            let slot = mgr
14326                .sessions
14327                .get(&pseudonym)
14328                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("slot for {pseudonym} must exist"))?;
14329            // Non-disabled balancer with a known target, so the KeepAlive branch is reachable.
14330            slot.surb_mgmt.update(&SurbBalancerConfig {
14331                target_surb_buffer_size: 100,
14332                ..Default::default()
14333            });
14334        }
14335
14336        let b_target_before = mgr
14337            .sessions
14338            .get(&b)
14339            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("slot for B must exist"))?
14340            .surb_mgmt
14341            .controller_bounds()
14342            .target();
14343
14344        let cross_keep_alive = KeepAliveMessage {
14345            session_id: b,
14346            flags: KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget.into(),
14347            additional_data: b_target_before + 1,
14348        };
14349
14350        // Through dispatch, the admission filter refuses it before any handler runs.
14351        let dispatched = mgr.dispatch_message(a, start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(cross_keep_alive.clone()))?);
14352        assert!(
14353            matches!(dispatched, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage))),
14354            "a keep-alive naming another session must be dropped at dispatch, got {dispatched:?}"
14355        );
14356
14357        // Point 4: the handler refuses it again even when reached directly, so the property does not
14358        // rest on the dispatch filter alone.
14359        mgr.handle_keep_alive(a, cross_keep_alive.clone())
14360            .await
14361            .context("the keep-alive handler must refuse quietly, not error")?;
14362        assert_eq!(
14363            b_target_before,
14364            mgr.sessions
14365                .get(&b)
14366                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("slot for B must exist"))?
14367                .surb_mgmt
14368                .controller_bounds()
14369                .target(),
14370            "a keep-alive naming another session must not move its balancer target"
14371        );
14372
14373        // The same for a post-establishment session error naming B.
14374        let cross_error = StartErrorType {
14375            identifier: ErrorIdentifier::SessionId(b),
14376            reason: StartErrorReason::Unknown,
14377        };
14378        let dispatched = mgr.dispatch_message(a, start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(cross_error.clone()))?);
14379        assert!(
14380            matches!(dispatched, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage))),
14381            "a session error naming another session must be dropped at dispatch, got {dispatched:?}"
14382        );
14383        mgr.handle_session_error(a, cross_error)
14384            .await
14385            .context("the session-error handler must refuse quietly, not error")?;
14386        assert!(
14387            mgr.active_sessions().contains(&b),
14388            "a session error naming another session must not close it"
14389        );
14390
14391        // Control: the same messages under B's own pseudonym do take effect. Dispatch hands the
14392        // message to the Start-protocol worker, so the effect is asynchronous and polled for.
14393        mgr.dispatch_message(
14394            b,
14395            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(KeepAliveMessage {
14396                session_id: b,
14397                flags: KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget.into(),
14398                additional_data: b_target_before + 2,
14399            }))?,
14400        )?;
14401        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), async {
14402            loop {
14403                let target = mgr
14404                    .sessions
14405                    .get(&b)
14406                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("slot for B must exist"))?
14407                    .surb_mgmt
14408                    .controller_bounds()
14409                    .target();
14410                if target == b_target_before + 2 {
14411                    return Ok::<(), anyhow::Error>(());
14412                }
14413                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
14414            }
14415        })
14416        .await
14417        .context("a correctly addressed keep-alive must still update the target")??;
14418
14419        mgr.dispatch_message(
14420            b,
14421            start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SessionError(StartErrorType {
14422                identifier: ErrorIdentifier::SessionId(b),
14423                reason: StartErrorReason::Unknown,
14424            }))?,
14425        )?;
14426        let closed = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), async {
14427            loop {
14428                if !mgr.active_sessions().contains(&b) {
14429                    return;
14430                }
14431                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
14432            }
14433        })
14434        .await
14435        .context("a correctly addressed session error must close the session");
14436        closed?;
14437
14438        sender.close_channel();
14439        Ok(())
14440    }

14442    /// Verifies that closing an existing session returns `true` and removes the session from the manager.
14443    ///
14444    /// ## Steps
14445    /// 1. A `SessionManager` is started with a mock transport that accepts one outbound message.
14446    /// 2. `handle_incoming_session_initiation` is called to create a session — one active session confirmed.
14447    /// 3. `close_session` is called with the session's pseudonym — returns `true`.
14448    /// 4. `num_active_sessions` is 0, confirming the session was fully removed.
14449    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
14450    async fn session_manager_should_return_true_when_closing_existing_session() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
14451        use hopr_utils::network_types::prelude::SealedHost;
14452
14453        let mgr: SessionManager<futures::channel::mpsc::UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>> =
14454            SessionManager::new(Default::default());
14455
14456        let mut transport = MockMsgSender::new();
14457        transport
14458            .expect_send_message()
14459            .once()
14460            .returning(|_, _| futures::future::ok(()).boxed());
14461
14462        let (new_session_tx, new_session_rx) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1);
14463        let _notifications = tokio::spawn(async move {
14464            pin_mut!(new_session_rx);
14465            while let Some(_session) = new_session_rx.next().await {}
14466        });
14467        let (sender, _handle) = mock_packet_planning(transport);
14468        mgr.start(sender.clone(), new_session_tx, None, None)?;
14469        assert!(mgr.is_started());
14470
14471        // Create a session
14472        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
14473        mgr.handle_incoming_session_initiation(
14474            pseudonym,
14475            StartInitiation {
14476                challenge: MIN_CHALLENGE,
14477                target: SessionTarget::TcpStream(SealedHost::Plain("127.0.0.1:80".parse()?)),
14478                capabilities: HoprSessionCapabilities::empty(),
14479                additional_data: 0,
14480            },
14481        )
14482        .await?;
14483
14484        // Verify session exists
14485        assert_eq!(mgr.active_sessions().len(), 1);
14486        assert_eq!(mgr.num_active_sessions(), 1);
14487
14488        // Close the session - should return true
14489        let result = mgr.close_session(&pseudonym);
14490        assert!(result, "closing existing session should return true");
14491
14492        // Verify session is closed
14493        assert_eq!(mgr.active_sessions().len(), 0);
14494        assert_eq!(mgr.num_active_sessions(), 0);
14495
14496        // Cleanup: close sender and await handle
14497        sender.close_channel();
14498        _handle.await??;
14499
14500        Ok(())
14501    }

14566                session,
14567                DestinationRouting::Forward {
14568                    destination: Box::new(destination.into()),
14569                    pseudonym: Some(session),
14570                    forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(1.try_into()?),
14571                    return_options: None,
14572                },

14574            let slot = mgr.sessions.get(&session).context("slot must exist")?;
14575            slot.surb_mgmt.update(&SurbBalancerConfig {
14576                target_surb_buffer_size: 100,
14577                ..Default::default()
14578            });
14579            slot.surb_mgmt
14580                .buffer_level
14581                .store(200, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);

14604    /// Verifies that an Exit `KeepAlive` updates the SURB buffer level and counts as returned service.
14605    ///
14606    /// ## Steps
14607    /// 1. A session slot is manually inserted into Alice's manager with a known `SurbBalancerConfig` and an initial
14608    ///    buffer level of 100.
14609    /// 2. A `KeepAlive` message with `KeepAliveFlag::BalancerState` and `additional_data: 200` is constructed and
14610    ///    dispatched to Alice's manager via `dispatch_message`.
14611    /// 3. The manager processes the keep-alive asynchronously; the test polls until the slot's `buffer_level` reaches
14612    ///    200 (with a 1-second timeout).
14613    /// 4. The buffer level is confirmed to be 200 and the returned-packet counter advances once.
14614    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
14615    async fn session_manager_should_update_buffer_level_on_keep_alive_with_balancer_state_flag() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
14616        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
14617
14618        let alice_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
14619        let session_id = alice_pseudonym;
14620        let initial_buffer_level = 100u64;
14621        let new_buffer_level = 200u64;
14622
14623        let balancer_cfg = SurbBalancerConfig {
14624            target_surb_buffer_size: 1000,
14625            max_surbs_per_sec: 100,
14626            ..Default::default()
14627        };
14628
14629        let alice_mgr =
14630            SessionManager::<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>::new(Default::default());
14631
14632        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
14633        let (mock_sender, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
14634        let _ahs = alice_mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
14635        assert!(alice_mgr.is_started());
14636
14637        let (dummy_tx, _) = crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async::<ApplicationDataIn>(SESSION_FORWARD_CAPACITY);
14638        let peer_address: Address = (&ChainKeypair::random()).into();
14639        alice_mgr.sessions.insert(
14640            session_id,
14641            SessionSlot {
14642                session_tx: dummy_tx,
14643                routing_opts: DestinationRouting::Forward {
14644                    destination: Box::new(peer_address.into()),
14645                    pseudonym: Some(alice_pseudonym),
14646                    forward_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(hopr_api::types::primitive::bounded::BoundedSize::MIN),
14647                    return_options: RoutingOptions::Hops(hopr_api::types::primitive::bounded::BoundedSize::MIN).into(),
14648                },
14649                abort_handles: Default::default(),
14650                surb_mgmt: Arc::new(BalancerStateValues::from(balancer_cfg)),
14651                surb_estimator: Default::default(),
14652                current_ssa_state: Default::default(),
14653                pix_supervisor: Default::default(),
14654                pix_egress_gate: Default::default(),
14655                pix_fill: Default::default(),
14656                returned_packets: Default::default(),
14657                cycle_budget: None,
14658                admission_token: Default::default(),
14659                raised_surb_target: Default::default(),
14660            },
14661        );
14662
14663        // Set initial buffer level
14664        let session_slot = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id).unwrap();
14665        session_slot
14666            .surb_mgmt
14667            .buffer_level
14668            .store(initial_buffer_level, Ordering::Relaxed);
14669        drop(session_slot);
14670
14671        // Verify initial buffer level
14672        let session_slot = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id).unwrap();
14673        assert_eq!(session_slot.surb_mgmt.buffer_level(), initial_buffer_level);
14674        drop(session_slot);
14675
14676        // Create keep-alive message with BalancerState flag
14677        let ka = KeepAliveMessage::<SessionId> {
14678            session_id,
14679            flags: KeepAliveFlag::BalancerState.into(),
14680            additional_data: new_buffer_level,
14681        };
14682        let app_data: ApplicationData = HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(ka).try_into()?;
14683        let app_data_in = ApplicationDataIn {
14684            data: app_data,
14685            packet_info: Default::default(),
14686        };
14687
14688        // Dispatch the keep-alive message
14689        alice_mgr.dispatch_message(alice_pseudonym, app_data_in)?;
14690
14691        // Poll until the background task has processed the keep-alive
14692        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
14693            loop {
14694                if let Some(slot) = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id)
14695                    && slot.surb_mgmt.buffer_level() == new_buffer_level
14696                {
14697                    break;
14698                }
14699                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
14700            }
14701        })
14702        .await
14703        .context("keep-alive BalancerState update timed out")?;
14704
14705        // Verify buffer level was updated
14706        let session_slot = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id).unwrap();
14707        assert_eq!(
14708            session_slot.surb_mgmt.buffer_level(),
14709            new_buffer_level,
14710            "buffer level should be updated via keep-alive with BalancerState flag"
14711        );
14712        assert_eq!(
14713            1,
14714            session_slot.returned_packets.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
14715            "an Exit keep-alive consumes a return SURB and must count toward the successor gate"
14716        );
14717
14718        Ok(())
14719    }

14721    /// Reading the admission token must not claim the cell.
14722    ///
14723    /// The Exit answers `SessionEstablished` before it commits, so a `BalancerTarget` keep-alive can
14724    /// be processed in that window. `claim_admission_token` exists for teardowns, which *claim* an
14725    /// empty cell by writing `NONE` into it — a keep-alive that did the same would make the
14726    /// establishment's own `set` fail, and its `commit` would then retire the admission it had just
14727    /// made. The Session's SURBs would land in the quarantine, which is exactly the unadmitted-Session
14728    /// failure the admission seam exists to prevent (hoprnet#8515).
14729    #[test]
14730    fn peeking_the_admission_token_must_leave_the_cell_for_the_commit() {
14731        let slot = {
14732            let (session_tx, _rx) = crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async::<ApplicationDataIn>(1);
14733            SessionSlot {
14734                session_tx,
14735                routing_opts: DestinationRouting::Return(SurbMatcher::Pseudonym(HoprPseudonym::random())),
14736                abort_handles: Default::default(),
14737                surb_mgmt: Default::default(),
14738                surb_estimator: Default::default(),
14739                current_ssa_state: Default::default(),
14740                pix_supervisor: Default::default(),
14741                pix_egress_gate: Default::default(),
14742                pix_fill: Default::default(),
14743                returned_packets: Default::default(),
14744                cycle_budget: None,
14745                admission_token: Default::default(),
14746                raised_surb_target: Default::default(),
14747            }
14748        };
14749
14750        assert_eq!(
14751            AdmissionToken::NONE,
14752            slot.peek_admission_token(),
14753            "a slot nothing has admitted yet holds no token"
14754        );
14755
14756        // The cell is still empty, so the establishment's commit can still take it.
14757        let minted = AdmissionToken::from_raw(7);
14758        assert!(
14759            slot.admission_token.set(minted).is_ok(),
14760            "peeking must not have claimed the cell"
14761        );
14762        assert_eq!(minted, slot.peek_admission_token());
14763    }

14765    /// Verifies that a `KeepAlive` message with the `BalancerTarget` flag updates the session's
14766    /// target SURB buffer size in the manager.
14767    ///
14768    /// ## Steps
14769    /// 1. A session slot is manually inserted into Alice's manager with a known `SurbBalancerConfig` and
14770    ///    `target_surb_buffer_size: 1000`.
14771    /// 2. A `KeepAlive` message with `KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget` and `additional_data: 2000` is constructed and
14772    ///    dispatched via `dispatch_message`.
14773    /// 3. The manager processes the keep-alive asynchronously; the test polls until the slot's
14774    ///    `target_surb_buffer_size` reaches 2000 (with a 1-second timeout).
14775    /// 4. The target is confirmed to be 2000, proving the `BalancerTarget` flag updated it.
14776    /// 5. The slot now records that the Entry refills the Exit's stock, which arms the Exit's keep-alive reserve: only
14777    ///    an Entry's SURB balancer sends keep-alives.
14778    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
14779    async fn session_manager_should_update_target_on_keep_alive_with_balancer_target_flag() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
14780        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
14781
14782        let alice_pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
14783        let session_id = alice_pseudonym;
14784        let initial_target = 1000u64;
14785        let new_target = 2000u64;
14786
14787        let balancer_cfg = SurbBalancerConfig {
14788            target_surb_buffer_size: initial_target,
14789            max_surbs_per_sec: 100,
14790            ..Default::default()
14791        };
14792
14793        let alice_mgr =
14794            SessionManager::<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>::new(Default::default());
14795
14796        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
14797        let (mock_sender, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
14798        let _ahs = alice_mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
14799        assert!(alice_mgr.is_started());
14800
14801        let (dummy_tx, _) = crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async::<ApplicationDataIn>(SESSION_FORWARD_CAPACITY);
14802        alice_mgr.sessions.insert(
14803            session_id,
14804            SessionSlot {
14805                session_tx: dummy_tx,
14806                routing_opts: DestinationRouting::Return(SurbMatcher::Pseudonym(alice_pseudonym)),
14807                abort_handles: Default::default(),
14808                surb_mgmt: Arc::new(BalancerStateValues::from(balancer_cfg)),
14809                surb_estimator: Default::default(),
14810                current_ssa_state: Default::default(),
14811                pix_supervisor: Default::default(),
14812                pix_egress_gate: Default::default(),
14813                pix_fill: Default::default(),
14814                returned_packets: Default::default(),
14815                cycle_budget: None,
14816                admission_token: Default::default(),
14817                raised_surb_target: Default::default(),
14818            },
14819        );
14820
14821        // Verify initial target
14822        let session_slot = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id).unwrap();
14823        assert_eq!(
14824            session_slot.surb_mgmt.controller_bounds().target(),
14825            initial_target,
14826            "initial target should be set"
14827        );
14828        assert!(
14829            !session_slot.surb_mgmt.counterparty_refills(),
14830            "no keep-alive yet, so nothing shows the Entry refills"
14831        );
14832        drop(session_slot);
14833
14834        // Create keep-alive message with BalancerTarget flag
14835        let ka = KeepAliveMessage::<SessionId> {
14836            session_id,
14837            flags: KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget.into(),
14838            additional_data: new_target,
14839        };
14840        let app_data: ApplicationData = HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(ka).try_into()?;
14841        let app_data_in = ApplicationDataIn {
14842            data: app_data,
14843            packet_info: Default::default(),
14844        };
14845
14846        // Dispatch the keep-alive message
14847        alice_mgr.dispatch_message(alice_pseudonym, app_data_in)?;
14848
14849        // Poll until the background task has processed the keep-alive
14850        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
14851            loop {
14852                if let Some(slot) = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id)
14853                    && slot.surb_mgmt.target_surb_buffer_size.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == new_target
14854                {
14855                    break;
14856                }
14857                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
14858            }
14859        })
14860        .await
14861        .context("keep-alive BalancerTarget update timed out")?;
14862
14863        // Verify target was updated
14864        let session_slot = alice_mgr.sessions.get(&session_id).unwrap();
14865        assert_eq!(
14866            session_slot.surb_mgmt.target_surb_buffer_size.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
14867            new_target,
14868            "target buffer size should be updated via keep-alive with BalancerTarget flag"
14869        );
14870        assert_eq!(
14871            0,
14872            session_slot.returned_packets.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
14873            "an Entry keep-alive received on the Exit must not count as returned Exit service"
14874        );
14875        assert!(
14876            session_slot.surb_mgmt.counterparty_refills(),
14877            "the Entry's keep-alive shows its balancer refills the Exit's stock"
14878        );
14879
14880        Ok(())
14881    }
14882
14883    /// An incoming Session (the Exit), registered with the estimator its keep-alives book into. The manager
14884    /// is not started: the test does that, and keeps the handles for as long as it runs.
14885    fn exit_slot_for_keep_alives(
14886        pseudonym: HoprPseudonym,
14887    ) -> (
14888        SessionManager<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>,
14889        AtomicSurbFlowEstimator,
14890    ) {
14891        let mgr = SessionManager::<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>::new(Default::default());
14892        let estimator = AtomicSurbFlowEstimator::default();
14893        let (dummy_tx, _) = crossfire::mpsc::bounded_blocking_async::<ApplicationDataIn>(SESSION_FORWARD_CAPACITY);
14894        mgr.sessions.insert(
14895            pseudonym,
14896            SessionSlot {
14897                session_tx: dummy_tx,
14898                routing_opts: DestinationRouting::Return(SurbMatcher::Pseudonym(pseudonym)),
14899                abort_handles: Default::default(),
14900                surb_mgmt: Arc::new(BalancerStateValues::from(SurbBalancerConfig::default())),
14901                surb_estimator: estimator.clone(),
14902                current_ssa_state: Default::default(),
14903                pix_supervisor: Default::default(),
14904                pix_egress_gate: Default::default(),
14905                pix_fill: Default::default(),
14906                returned_packets: Default::default(),
14907                cycle_budget: None,
14908                admission_token: Default::default(),
14909                raised_surb_target: Default::default(),
14910            },
14911        );
14912        (mgr, estimator)
14913    }
14914
14915    /// Dispatches a keep-alive from the Entry whose packet stored `saved` SURBs and lost `evicted`. The
14916    /// SURBs are booked as it is dispatched; the rest of the keep-alive (that the Entry refills, and
14917    /// any target it announces) is handled asynchronously by the manager's Start protocol task.
14918    ///
14919    /// `flags` is what the Entry's balancer says: [`KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget`] is one that
14920    /// announces its target, and no flags one that has `surb_target_notify` off. It announces a target
14921    /// of zero either way, which changes nothing on the Exit.
14922    fn dispatch_entry_keep_alive(
14923        mgr: &SessionManager<UnboundedSender<(DestinationRouting, ApplicationDataOut)>>,
14924        pseudonym: HoprPseudonym,
14925        flags: KeepAliveFlags,
14926        saved: usize,
14927        evicted: usize,
14928    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
14929        let keep_alive = KeepAliveMessage::<SessionId> {
14930            session_id: pseudonym,
14931            flags,
14932            additional_data: 0,
14933        };
14934        mgr.dispatch_message(
14935            pseudonym,
14936            ApplicationDataIn {
14937                data: HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(keep_alive).try_into()?,
14938                packet_info: IncomingPacketInfo {
14939                    num_saved_surbs: saved,
14940                    num_evicted_surbs: evicted,
14941                    ..Default::default()
14942                },
14943            },
14944        )?;
14945        Ok(())
14946    }
14947
14948    /// A keep-alive from the Entry delivers SURBs to the Exit just as a data packet does, and the Entry's
14949    /// balancer mints about as many of them in keep-alives as in data. What the packet did to the store
14950    /// is booked from the packet: the SURBs it carried, and the ones the store lost to it. The second is
14951    /// how the stock a newer SURB generation wiped reaches the Exit's level; a keep-alive that carried the
14952    /// first batch of the new generation used to leave it booked as still held.
14953    ///
14954    /// (The SURBs booked used to be the message's `max_surbs()`, how many fit beside it. That is what the
14955    /// sender was allowed to send, not what the store took.)
14956    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
14957    async fn a_keep_alive_should_book_the_surbs_its_packet_stored_and_the_ones_it_evicted() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
14958        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
14959
14960        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
14961        let (mgr, estimator) = exit_slot_for_keep_alives(pseudonym);
14962        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
14963        let (mock_sender, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
14964        let _ahs = mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
14965
14966        // The first batch of a newer generation: it wipes a stock of 7000 and stores its own two SURBs.
14967        dispatch_entry_keep_alive(&mgr, pseudonym, KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget.into(), 2, 7_000)?;
14968
14969        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
14970            while estimator.produced.load(Relaxed) == 0 {
14971                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
14972            }
14973        })
14974        .await
14975        .context("the keep-alive was never booked")?;
14976        assert_eq!(2, estimator.produced.load(Relaxed), "the SURBs the packet carried");
14977        assert_eq!(
14978            7_000,
14979            estimator.evicted.load(Relaxed),
14980            "the stock the store lost to it, which is what makes the wipe visible to the Exit's level"
14981        );
14982        Ok(())
14983    }
14984
14985    /// The same keep-alive on a store that lost nothing books no eviction.
14986    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
14987    async fn a_keep_alive_that_evicted_nothing_should_book_no_eviction() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
14988        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
14989
14990        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
14991        let (mgr, estimator) = exit_slot_for_keep_alives(pseudonym);
14992        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
14993        let (mock_sender, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
14994        let _ahs = mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
14995
14996        dispatch_entry_keep_alive(&mgr, pseudonym, KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget.into(), 2, 0)?;
14997
14998        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), async {
14999            while estimator.produced.load(Relaxed) == 0 {
15000                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
15001            }
15002        })
15003        .await
15004        .context("the keep-alive was never booked")?;
15005        assert_eq!(2, estimator.produced.load(Relaxed));
15006        assert_eq!(0, estimator.evicted.load(Relaxed));
15007        Ok(())
15008    }

15010    /// An `SsaCommit` from the Entry delivers SURBs into the Exit's ring just as a keep-alive does, and
15011    /// is booked the same way. Booking only the keep-alives left these out of the Exit's level while
15012    /// the evictions they caused later were booked.
15013    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
15014    async fn an_ssa_commit_should_book_the_surbs_its_packet_stored() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
15015        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
15016
15017        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
15018        let (mgr, estimator) = exit_slot_for_keep_alives(pseudonym);
15019        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
15020        let (mock_sender, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
15021        let _ahs = mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
15022
15023        let identity = HoprPixGroupElement::try_from(
15024            hopr_protocol_pix::PixGroup::<HoprPixSpec>::default()
15025                .to_bytes()
15026                .as_ref(),
15027        )
15028        .ok()
15029        .context("identity element must be valid")?;
15030        let mut packet = start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::SsaCommit(SsaClientCommitmentMessage {
15031            session_id: pseudonym,
15032            ssa_index: SsaIndex::new(1).context("non-zero")?,
15033            coefficient_index: 1,
15034            commitment_proof: None,
15035            coefficient_commitments: [(0, identity)].into(),
15036        }))?;
15037        packet.packet_info.num_saved_surbs = 2;
15038        packet.packet_info.num_evicted_surbs = 1;
15039        let carried = packet.num_surbs_with_msg() as u64;
15040        assert!(carried > 0, "fixture: the commitment must leave room for a SURB");
15041
15042        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet)?;
15043
15044        assert_eq!(
15045            carried,
15046            estimator.produced.load(Relaxed),
15047            "the SURBs the commitment's packet carried"
15048        );
15049        assert_eq!(1, estimator.evicted.load(Relaxed), "and the one the store lost to them");
15050        Ok(())
15051    }

15053    /// The SURBs are in the ring before the message is looked at, so a Start message the admission
15054    /// filter turns away is booked all the same: here a keep-alive that names another Session.
15055    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
15056    async fn a_start_message_the_admission_filter_drops_should_still_book_its_surbs() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
15057        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
15058
15059        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
15060        let (mgr, estimator) = exit_slot_for_keep_alives(pseudonym);
15061        let (new_session_tx, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
15062        let (mock_sender, _) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
15063        let _ahs = mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
15064
15065        let mut packet = start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::KeepAlive(KeepAliveMessage {
15066            session_id: HoprPseudonym::random(),
15067            flags: KeepAliveFlag::BalancerTarget.into(),
15068            additional_data: 0,
15069        }))?;
15070        packet.packet_info.num_saved_surbs = 2;
15071        let carried = packet.num_surbs_with_msg() as u64;
15072        assert!(carried > 0, "fixture: the keep-alive must leave room for a SURB");
15073
15074        let dispatched = mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet);
15075        assert!(
15076            matches!(dispatched, Ok(DispatchResult::Dropped(DropReason::StaleStartMessage))),
15077            "the filter must drop a keep-alive naming another session, got {dispatched:?}"
15078        );
15079        assert_eq!(
15080            carried,
15081            estimator.produced.load(Relaxed),
15082            "dropped, but its SURBs are in the ring"
15083        );
15084        Ok(())
15085    }

15087    /// The opening `StartSession` carries SURBs too. They reach the pseudonym's ring before the Session
15088    /// exists, and admission promotes them with it, so the new Session's estimate starts with them:
15089    /// without them it would start, and stay, below what the ring holds.
15090    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
15091    async fn the_opening_message_should_seed_the_exit_estimate() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
15092        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
15093
15094        let (mgr, _sender, _transport, _err_rx, _incoming) =
15095            started_manager_admitting_small_params(1..=small_params_quota(), false, None)?;
15096        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
15097
15098        let mut packet = start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(pix_offer()))?;
15099        packet.packet_info.num_saved_surbs = 2;
15100        let carried = packet.num_surbs_with_msg() as u64;
15101        assert!(carried > 0, "fixture: the opening must leave room for a SURB");
15102
15103        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet)?;
15104
15105        let produced = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
15106            loop {
15107                if let Some(slot) = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym) {
15108                    let produced = slot.surb_estimator.produced.load(Relaxed);
15109                    if produced > 0 {
15110                        return produced;
15111                    }
15112                }
15113                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
15114            }
15115        })
15116        .await
15117        .context("the opening's SURBs were never booked")?;
15118        assert_eq!(carried, produced, "the SURBs the opening's packet carried");
15119        Ok(())
15120    }

15122    /// What the ring lost when the opening arrived is not the new Session's to book: its estimate never
15123    /// counted that stock, which a newer generation superseded from an earlier Session under the same
15124    /// pseudonym. Booked, it would start the estimate below the SURBs the opening brought, and the
15125    /// keep-alive reserve would hold data back with the ring holding them.
15126    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
15127    async fn an_opening_should_not_book_the_stock_it_superseded() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
15128        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
15129
15130        let (mgr, _sender, _transport, _err_rx, _incoming) =
15131            started_manager_admitting_small_params(1..=small_params_quota(), false, None)?;
15132        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
15133
15134        let mut packet = start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(pix_offer()))?;
15135        packet.packet_info.num_saved_surbs = 2;
15136        packet.packet_info.num_evicted_surbs = 40;
15137        let carried = packet.num_surbs_with_msg() as u64;
15138        assert!(carried > 0, "fixture: the opening must leave room for a SURB");
15139
15140        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet)?;
15141
15142        let (produced, evicted) = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
15143            loop {
15144                if let Some(slot) = mgr.sessions.get(&pseudonym) {
15145                    let produced = slot.surb_estimator.produced.load(Relaxed);
15146                    if produced > 0 {
15147                        return (produced, slot.surb_estimator.evicted.load(Relaxed));
15148                    }
15149                }
15150                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10)).await;
15151            }
15152        })
15153        .await
15154        .context("the opening's SURBs were never booked")?;
15155        assert_eq!(carried, produced, "the SURBs the opening's packet carried");
15156        assert_eq!(0, evicted, "the superseded stock belonged to an earlier Session");
15157        Ok(())
15158    }

15160    /// An opening repeated for a Session that already exists is booked once, in dispatch. The Start
15161    /// task refuses it, and must not book it again: a wipe it reported would be subtracted twice.
15162    #[test_log::test(tokio::test)]
15163    async fn a_repeated_opening_should_be_booked_once() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
15164        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed;
15165
15166        let pseudonym = HoprPseudonym::random();
15167        let (mgr, estimator) = exit_slot_for_keep_alives(pseudonym);
15168        let (new_session_tx, _new_sessions) = futures::channel::mpsc::channel(1024);
15169        let (mock_sender, mut sent) = futures::channel::mpsc::unbounded();
15170        let _ahs = mgr.start(mock_sender, new_session_tx, None, None)?;
15171
15172        let mut packet = start_packet(HoprStartProtocol::StartSession(no_pix_offer()))?;
15173        packet.packet_info.num_saved_surbs = 2;
15174        packet.packet_info.num_evicted_surbs = 1;
15175        let carried = packet.num_surbs_with_msg() as u64;
15176        assert!(carried > 0, "fixture: the opening must leave room for a SURB");
15177
15178        mgr.dispatch_message(pseudonym, packet)?;
15179        // The refusal proves the Start task handled the duplicate. A second booking would come after it,
15180        // so the task is given a moment to finish before looking.
15181        let (_, refusal) = timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), sent.next())
15182            .await
15183            .context("the duplicate opening was never refused")?
15184            .context("the manager's sender closed before the refusal")?;
15185        assert!(
15186            crate::testing::msg_type(&refusal, StartProtocolDiscriminants::SessionError),
15187            "the Start task refuses the duplicate with a SessionError"
15188        );
15189        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
15190
15191        assert_eq!(carried, estimator.produced.load(Relaxed), "booked once");
15192        assert_eq!(1, estimator.evicted.load(Relaxed), "and its eviction once");
15193        Ok(())
15194    }
